desc:
Break eggs, discover rare pets, battle other players, and carry the pets back to your base. Watch out for the guardian beast chasing you!

⛏️ Crack eggs and discover rare pets.
⚔️ Battle other players to fight over rare pets.
💪 Lift heavy pets and escape the guardian beast’s pursuit.
🏠 Bring pets back to your base to earn coins non‑stop.
⚡ Upgrade your pickaxe to crack harder eggs.
🏋️ Increase your strength to carry heavier pets.
📖 Collect all pets and finish your collection book.

👍 Love this game? Feel free to leave a like to support us.
❤️ Join our group to get extra rewards.
